en: The postcard depicts a black-and-white image of a large Romanesque cathedral with a prominent rose window, arcaded façade, and an octagonal dome, accompanied by a bell tower on the right. In front of the cathedral, there is a large ornate fountain with statues. The image has a vintage, early 20th-century appearance. In the upper right corner, there is printed red text.
